source: GWAS Catalog REST v2 /studies?reportedTrait=<term> (exact); legacy v1 /gwas/rest/api returns HTTP 410 Gone

F2_volume.registered: Areal BMD replaced by a volumetric / area-conditioned BMD instrument, tested against the same hip and knee OA outcomes.
F2_volume.need: Common-SNP GWAS of true volumetric BMD (vBMD), cortical/trabecular vBMD, bone area or bone width with full summary statistics and enough genome-wide significant loci to build >=10 independent instruments; ideally site-matched to the OA outcomes.

F5_hip_osteophyte.registered: Stratify the OA outcome by osteophyte-predominant versus joint-space-narrowing subtype; registered endpoint is hip osteophyte.
F5_hip_osteophyte.need: Hip-osteophyte GWAS with common-SNP summary statistics (the OARSI 2024 abstract, 52,024 participants, IGFBP3 locus, has no deposited file).

F10_cross_ancestry.registered: Re-run BMD->OA MR in non-European (EAS) OA with ancestry-matched instruments / ancestry-stratified outcome.
F10_cross_ancestry.need: De novo non-European BMD instruments plus an ancestry-stratified KNEE-OA outcome (Hatzikotoulas 2025 knee OA, GCST90566800), or an adequately powered non-European total-body DXA BMD GWAS paired with the same outcome definition.

adjudication.label: Garg 2026 AJHG CNV PheWAS: pelvis / legs / femoral-neck bone area
adjudication.reason: Bone-area traits are measured, but the variants are copy-number burden calls from sequencing read depth (N=39,704 EUR), not common SNPs. They cannot serve as the areal-BMD-replacing volumetric instrument set and would not overlap the 31 BMD instruments.

adjudication.label: Nielson 2016 trabecular lumbar-spine BMD, N=12,287 EUR
adjudication.reason: True volumetric/trabecular BMD phenotype, but summaryStatistics=NA in the Catalog; no instrument set can be reconstructed.

adjudication.label: Zhang 2020 'BMD (hip) and hip bone size' bivariate GWAS
adjudication.reason: Bivariate (pleiotropy-selected) statistic with no deposited file; even if available it is not a pure volumetric BMD instrument.

adjudication.label: Backman 2021 UKB exome: knee / any-site osteophyte ICD10 burden
adjudication.reason: Exome-wide rare coding-variant / gene-burden files, not common-SNP GWAS; 0/31 exact chr:bp matches against the locked BMD instruments (verified 2026-11-09), and the endpoint is knee or any-site, not hip.

adjudication.label: Lumbar spondylosis osteophytes / ankle-foot osteophyte
adjudication.reason: Wrong anatomical site and (for GCST005278) no deposited summary statistics; the registered hip-osteophyte GWAS remains only an OARSI 2024 conference abstract.

adjudication.label: Pan-UKB 2025 Central/South Asian heel BMD (UKB f.3148), N=2,633
adjudication.reason: Non-European BMD summary statistics do exist (harmonised 484 MB, GRCh37, .tbi), but N=2,633 heel quantitative ultrasound is a different bone phenotype from total-body DXA areal BMD and is far too small for de novo instrument discovery; using European instruments against it would be a portability check, not replication.

adjudication.label: Medina-Gomez 2018 total-body BMD (incl. 1,333 AA) / GEFOS 2012 FN BMD
adjudication.reason: Deposited files are pooled multi-ancestry or European-dominant meta-analyses, not ancestry-specific instrument-discovery GWAS.

adjudication.label: MVP+UKB McDonald 2022 ancestry-stratified OA (SAS 7,162; EAS 1,704; AFR 7,188/35,753)
adjudication.reason: Ancestry-stratified OA summary statistics DO exist, but the trait is all-site osteoarthritis, not the knee-OA endpoint of the registered test; harmonised files are 0.79-1.0 GB and no ancestry-matched BMD instrument set exists to pair with them.

adjudication.label: Genes & Health 2026 British South Asian OA excluding spine, N=44,026
adjudication.reason: Large non-European OA GWAS with deposited harmonised statistics, but exome-wide sequencing of rare coding variants (GRCh38), an 'excluding spine' all-site endpoint, and no knee-OA definition; common-SNP BMD instruments cannot be harmonised to it.

adjudication.label: Previously staged 'European-restricted knee OA' file
adjudication.reason: This is the X-chromosome knee-OA GWAS (all rows chr23), not a European-restricted autosomal outcome; 0/31 autosomal BMD instruments match. The S11 sentence claiming a staged EUR file was factually wrong and has been corrected.

conclusion.F2_volume: UNEXECUTED - no fit-for-purpose common-SNP volumetric BMD summary statistics; geometry arm and conditional MVMR stand.
conclusion.F5_hip_osteophyte: UNEXECUTED - no hip-osteophyte common-SNP GWAS; site-stratified surrogate (Table S29) stands.
conclusion.F10_cross_ancestry: UNEXECUTED - non-European / ancestry-stratified files now exist but none are fit for purpose; Table S32 ancestry-composition proxy stands and is NOT a replication; S23 verdict 9/10 unchanged.

wording_note: Blanket phrases such as 'no public ancestry-stratified data' and 'no non-European BMD exposure summary statistics are available' are imprecise as of 2026-11-09 and were replaced by 'no fit-for-purpose / no ancestry-stratified summary statistics for this outcome study'.
